about: Six camera spots for the main region outside CP (phase 6 of docs/DELHI_MAIN_PLAN.md), same format as cp_views.json. Move the car with window.__next.city.transit.onTeleport(x, z, yaw). Only k1 (day and dusk) was looked at and k2 for its street name and area; onTeleport does not seem to apply the yaw (the car faced across the road at k1 at dusk), so turn the car by hand (21 Nov 2026); the rest are first guesses from the landmark positions in src/world/city/places.js and must be adjusted after looking.
